title: Qatar MotoGP 2025
metaDescription: Qatar MotoGP 2025 opened the season at Lusail International Circuit under the circuit's floodlights.

overview.about: The Qatar Grand Prix at the Lusail International Circuit near Doha is MotoGP's landmark night race, run under floodlights across the desert. It has frequently opened the season, and its long main straight produces slipstreaming battles and photo-finishes. The 2027 race is on 11-13 April.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 Qatar Grand Prix runs 11-13 April under the lights at Lusail. Cooler night-time desert conditions and the long front straight set up close slipstream racing into the first corner.
